project_info.theme: Student success story for admission to INSA Lyon
project_info.color_palette: Lavender, Cream, Navy Blue, Red, Warm Skin Tones

main_subject.detail: A scrapbook-style student success poster for Nguyễn Bảo Minh Sơn, featuring a cream note panel with academic bullet points on the left, two polaroid photos of the student on the right, and admission proof documents arranged along the bottom.
main_subject.style: Youthful academic success poster with layered paper textures, travel-study symbols, institutional proof documents, and bold high-school identity cues.

items: Top Left: Large cream nameplate 'NGUYỄN BẢO MINH SƠN' and VFE logo above.
Top Right: Polaroid portrait of the student with medals, a mini Eiffel Tower model, and Paris postal doodle.
Bottom Left: Admission table screenshot and INSA Lyon attestation document.
Bottom Right: Second polaroid photo of the student playing guitar with label 'Tân sinh viên INSA Lyon', plus red CTA button 'NHẬN TƯ VẤN NGAY'.
Center/Background: Purple locker-like backdrop and cream note panel containing five bullet academic highlights.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Paper-layer contrast, casual youth-photo warmth, readable document overlays, and cheerful success-story polish.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality admissions success poster for Nguyễn Bảo Minh Sơn and INSA Lyon. Centerpiece is a scrapbook collage with a cream bullet-point panel on the left, polaroid student photos on the right, and official admission documents across the bottom. Background is a purple locker-like wall with a VFE logo, mini Eiffel Tower, and Paris travel doodle. Surrounding elements: academic highlights including WICO 2024, TCF B2, and 3/3 admission offers, high-school identity '2K8 Chuyên Lý THPT Chuyên KHTN, Hà Nội', and red CTA 'NHẬN TƯ VẤN NGAY'. Technical style: scrapbook-style admissions case study poster, soft paper-layer contrast, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
